_doc: CHECKBOX_BUILD_BUILDER_TOOLCHAIN (owner 2026-11-06: the checker box with git + dotnet + cv2 is top priority; redesign_final.md WP-02). What every walled Marker box carries so it can run what the builder ran: relentless_wall.box_config reads this file; make_box, unit_env, marker_prompt and toolchain_probe act on it; relentless_reach.needs stops calling these 'unreachable'.
_default_grants: Every box gets a read-only git history at the candidate (relentless_wall.grant_git): HEAD detached at the sha, no refs, the shared object stores bound read only. Before this a box got it only after a passed reach repair of its class, so history-dependent proofs (git rev-parse HEAD, git show <rev>:path, code-commit checks) went blind first and were repaired one class at a time.
_path_prepend: Put ahead of the unit's PATH when the folder exists: a venv over the system python3 (--system-site-packages) that adds opencv-python-headless, so `python3 -c 'import cv2, numpy'` runs in the box. Make or confirm it on any host with venv_fix.
venv_fix: python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/provision_checkbox_venv.py (idempotent: uv, or python3 -m venv + pip; numpy pinned to the system's; --check reads only)

toolchain.name: git
toolchain.why: the default git_history grant: history-dependent proofs run in the box

toolchain.name: python_cv2
toolchain.why: art and image proofs import cv2/numpy

toolchain.name: windows_build
toolchain.why: the Windows build stage: walls.marker.write_through binds it read-write as drvfs and WSL interop starts dotnet.exe, so winbuild.py builds the candidate's C# from the box's tree

_reach_served: relentless_reach.needs no longer counts these as out of the box's reach: plain git history verbs over the candidate's ancestry (not fetch/pull/branch/for-each-ref/reflog, which need refs or a remote) and winbuild.py. Other .exe, powershell and wslpath stay needs.
